intro.title: Every appointment starts with a conversation.
intro.text: Before anyone picks up scissors or a color bowl, your stylist sits down with you to talk through what you want, how you wear your hair day to day and what it will take to keep it. Then they do the work without rushing it.
intro.imageAlt: The studio's front desk under a white arch, with color products shelved behind it

policies.title: New color clients
policies.text: Book a free 15-minute consultation first, so we can patch test and plan the color.

policies.title: Running late
policies.text: Text us. More than 15 minutes late, we may need to move your appointment.

policies.title: Cancelling
policies.text: Please give us 24 hours' notice so someone on the waiting list can take the time.

stylists.name: Lauren
stylists.bio: Lauren opened the studio in 2014 after ten years behind the chair in Houston. She does most of the studio's balayage and corrective color.

stylists.name: Danielle
stylists.bio: Danielle loves a precise cut: bobs, shags and anything with a sharp line. She also does the studio's keratin treatments.

stylists.name: Imani
stylists.bio: Imani works with curls and coils of every type, from silk presses to curl-by-curl cuts, and keeps the studio's Saturdays busy.

stylists.name: Sam
stylists.bio: Sam does men's and gender-neutral cuts, lived-in color and most of the studio's wedding-day styling.

reviews.author: Color client
reviews.text: I have been chasing the right blonde for years and Lauren got it in one appointment. It grew out soft, with no line at the root, and I went eleven weeks before I needed to come back.

reviews.author: Regular since 2019
reviews.text: Danielle listens. I brought one blurry photo and she still knew exactly what I meant.

reviews.author: First visit
reviews.text: Imani was so patient with my curls and showed me how to style them at home. The studio is calm and bright and nobody rushed me.
